name: Hivemind Drone
body:
HIVEMIND DRONE
CR 6 MR 1

Agile hivemind mesmerist human aristocrat 2
N Medium humanoid (hivemind, human)
Init +21, dual initiative; Senses Perception +0

DEFENSE

AC 13, touch 12, flat-footed 11 (+1 Dex, +3 dodge, +1 natural)
hp 17 (2d8+8)
Fort +0, Ref +1, Will +3
Defensive Abilities evasion, hive mind

OFFENSE

Speed 60 ft.
Melee unarmed strike +0 (1d3–1)
Special Attacks hypnotic stare, painful stare (+1 damage)
Mesmerist Spells Known (CL 2nd, concentration +6)

1st Level (2/day)—murderous command (DC 15)
0-Level (2/day)—daze (DC 14), unwitting ally (DC 14)

STATISTICS

Str 8, Dex 13, Con 10, Int 11, Wis 10, Cha 18
Base Atk +1; CMB +0; CMD 12
Feats Conduit Casting *, Dodge, Skill Focus (Diplomacy)
Skills Bluff +8, Diplomacy +12, Knowledge (nobility) +5, Knowledge (religion) +4, Perform (dance) +9, Perform (sing, string instruments) +8, Ride +5, Sense Motive +4
Languages Common
SQ assume identity +2, assume knowledge, mesmerist trick (fearsome guise) 1/day
Gear alluring philter (150 gp), fetish of natural armor +1 (1,500 gp), hypnotist’s locket (pocket watch) (250 gp), mesmerist’s kit (35 gp), noble’s outfit (75 gp)
